screened_clusters.mechanism: Caller-bound immutable execution-generation fence across reservation, attempt/retry and provider precommit
screened_clusters.prediction: A stale/unbound caller cannot reach effect-attempt state after generation turnover, even if it knows effect_id or observes a globally current epoch.
screened_clusters.falsifier: A simpler mechanism using physical serialization plus idempotent provider semantics matches stale-caller, ABA, crash/retry and uncertainty behavior at lower cost without caller-bound generation capability.
screened_clusters.internal_evidence: Fresh-main V14 negative; stale first attempt, same-key retry and unbound caller reached COMMITTING; strict replication passed 10/10 fence matrix.

screened_clusters.mechanism: Open-web content is structurally non-authoritative; authority/control flow is separated from untrusted data flow.
screened_clusters.prediction: Indirect prompt injection cannot directly mint effect authority when raw web content cannot enter privileged instruction/capability channels.
screened_clusters.falsifier: Semantic influence through model-visible derived content or memory bypasses structural labels and changes privileged decisions without a detectable taint/provenance path.

screened_clusters.mechanism: Long-horizon memory needs execution-state/revision structure in addition to semantic similarity retrieval.
screened_clusters.prediction: State-path/branch-aware memory improves recovery, error isolation and long-horizon task success with bounded active context.
screened_clusters.falsifier: Semantic RAG plus compact summaries matches success/recovery while using materially lower state-management overhead.

screened_clusters.mechanism: Adaptive recurrence should continue only while expected marginal utility exceeds compute/instability cost and unresolved pressure remains material.
screened_clusters.prediction: Difficulty-/confidence-/stability-aware recurrence beats fixed-depth and always-deep recurrence on outcome-per-cost and failure rate.
screened_clusters.falsifier: A fixed shallow or fixed-depth policy matches accuracy/recovery across held-out difficulty while being cheaper and more stable.

screened_clusters.mechanism: Bandwidth-limited shared workspace with competition/broadcast can improve coordination and cross-modal transfer.
screened_clusters.prediction: A causally instrumented workspace improves tasks requiring specialist coordination and cross-modal reuse beyond simpler shared-memory/cross-attention baselines.
screened_clusters.falsifier: Lesioning explicit workspace while preserving equivalent information flow leaves outcome, transfer and coordination unchanged.

screened_clusters.mechanism: Higher-order Hyperposition/hypergraph relations are useful when an interaction is irreducible to pairwise edges.
screened_clusters.prediction: Matched-input hypergraph representation improves multi-hop/higher-order tasks without unacceptable latency/memory cost.
screened_clusters.falsifier: Pairwise graph/factorized representation matches outcomes under identical evidence and budget.

screened_clusters.mechanism: Authoritative event/state plane plus rebuildable projections improves replay, recovery, provenance and auditability.
screened_clusters.prediction: Append-only causal/authority events + checkpoints/materialized projections outperform ad hoc mutable state on recovery/replay correctness while meeting latency/resource budgets.
screened_clusters.falsifier: Simple normalized transactional state with explicit versions matches recovery/provenance and is materially simpler/faster.

screened_clusters.mechanism: Typed ClayCode IR/DSL at semantic and effect boundaries improves compliance, verifiability and tool orchestration.
screened_clusters.prediction: Typed lowering catches semantic/authority errors before execution and improves structured task reliability relative to semantically equivalent JSON/Python/schema baselines.
screened_clusters.falsifier: Ordinary typed host-language structures or schema-constrained tool calls match correctness/security with lower compiler/runtime complexity.

screened_clusters.mechanism: Persistent goals and bounded proactive agency can improve long-horizon behavior, but initiative must not self-reward or preempt active user work.
screened_clusters.prediction: Persistent hierarchical goals/checkpoints improve task continuity and self-initiated useful work without increasing semantic livelock or goal drift.
screened_clusters.falsifier: Reactive-only execution with explicit external tasks matches long-horizon utility, or proactive loops increase livelock/cost without verified outcome gains.
